articles.title: HERE'S HOW YOU STOP FIXING THE SAME ACCESSIBILITY BUGS TWICE
articles.summary:
Tired of fixing the same accessibility issues sprint after sprint? Level Access's on-demand webinar, “In-Flow Accessibility: Prevent Backlogs, Increase Velocity [5],” provides a practical framework for stopping bugs at the source.

You'll learn:

* How a proactive approach to accessibility saves time and money by empowering teams to fix issues when it's fastest and cheapest. * The limitations of the traditional “shift left” model (simply testing earlier). * Tools and tactics for making accessibility a seamless part of developers' day-to-day workflows.

articles.summary: AI is weakening traditional software moats and squeezing the middle. Software may split between massive platforms and small niche products.

articles.title: POPULAR ISN'T A BUSINESS MODEL
articles.summary: Open source can drive adoption, but it does not create a business by itself. Companies need to identify what becomes valuable enough for users to pay for.

articles.title: CONNECTING PRODUCT OUTCOMES TO BUSINESS STRATEGY
articles.summary: Product outcomes should connect directly to business strategy through a clear hierarchy of goals. The Strategy Stack keeps product teams autonomous while aligned with company priorities.

articles.title: HOW SHOULD WE APPROACH THE SOFTWARE FACTORY AS A PRODUCT TEAM?
articles.summary: AI software factories should encode human judgment into automated feedback, not just produce more code. Teams should learn through real product work and continuously improve how their agents operate.
